test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Though technology has advanced, environmental problems still have a drastic ______ on mankind.
solution: The correct answer is **"impact."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Impact"** means a strong effect or influence, which fits the context of the sentence. (परिणाम या प्रभाव) • **Example**:* She has a big **impact**__ on her.* • **"Result"** and **"purpose"** do not convey the same meaning as** "impact"** in this context. • **"Assume" **is completely unrelated to the sentence and does not make sense. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *Though technology has advanced, environmental problems still have a drastic __**impact**__ on mankind.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - "Result"** means the outcome of an action or event, but it doesn't fit the context of the sentence. (परिणाम, नतीजा, फल (किसी अन्‍य बात के कारण घटित स्थिति); अंतिम स्थिति (घटनाओं की शृंखला की)) • **Option 2 - "Purpose"** means the reason for which something is done or created, but it doesn't fit the context of the sentence. ((किसी का) प्रयोजन, उद्देश्‍य, आशय या इरादा) • **Option 4 - "Assume"** means to suppose something without evidence, which is completely unrelated to the sentence. (प्रमाण न होते हुए भी किसी बात को सत्‍य मान लेना; किसी बात के सत्‍य होने की आशा या अपेक्षा करना) 16e:Tda9, The correct answer is **"fined; deeds."**
